data: 死魂灵改换了故事，以至于你得同时面对双王侍卫以及......等等，先祖们什么时候成为双王禁军的？！
レヴァナントが物語を書き換えたことで、あなたが対峙するのは二人の王の護衛と……いや、待て。先祖たちはいつの間に二人の王の禁軍になったんだ！？
The revenants changed the tale again, so this time you'll be facing the twin kings and their royal guard... Wait, since when were the ancestors themselves the royal guard?!
拥有阿纳萨羯磨时，敌方单位的生命值、攻击力和防御力提升至125%
额外出现托生莲座×2，且后续出现被召唤的敌方单位时额外出现托生莲座
「アナサのカルマ」所持している時、敵全員の攻撃力+25%、防御力+25%、最大HP+25%
When having the relic <Anasa's Karma>, all enemy units have +25% ATK, +25% DEF, +25% Max HP, and <Padmasana of Rebirth> appears
萨卡兹王庭军精锐战士
サルカズ王庭軍戦士隊長
Recovers 3 SP for every Sarkaz enemy defeated

Strikes all allied units on the field once with Arts damage and summons several enemies; the damage dealt gradually increases every time Shock of Will is cast (initial multiplier 50%, increases by 20% every time, max multiplier 500%)
More likely to be attacked; once defeated, drops 1 Plan
Creates Mark of Epoch in the surrounding area; allied units within the Mark of Epoch receive continuous Necrosis damage
